description: First floor front extension; single and two storey rear extension; rear patio with steps; landscaping; external alterations
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
proposal, by reason of the site being located within an area of land liable to
flooding and the lack of a comprehensive Flood Risk Assessment, due to a lack
of up to date flood maps/data, has failed to demonstrate that the proposed
development would not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or
increase the risk and consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies SI12 and SI13 of The London
Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM9
and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management Polices Local Plan (2013).</span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The proposed patio/terraced decking, by virtue
of its height and proximity to the boundary shared with No. 28 Murray Crescent,
would result an unreasonable degree of increased overlooking and a loss of
privacy to No. 28 Murray Crescent. The proposal is therefore contrary to the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3.D(7) of the London Plan
(2021), policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan
(2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design
Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>
